grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD AS CODPRODUTO, PRO.COMPLDESC AS NOMEPRODUTO, COUNT(SER.SERIE) AS SERIAL FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFSER SER ON (ITE.NUNOTA = SER.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = SER.CODPROD) WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.COMPLDESC

grid.title: SERIAIS VINCULADOS NO PEDIDO
grid.expression: SELECT ITE.NUNOTA, ITE.CODPROD AS CODPRODUTO, PRO.COMPLDESC AS NOMEPRODUTO, SER.SERIE AS SERIAL, CAB.CODPARC AS CODPARCEIRO, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS NOMEPARCEIRO, CAB.DTFATUR AS DATAFATURAMENTO, CAB.NUMNOTA AS NUMERONOTA FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFSER SER ON (ITE.NUNOTA = SER.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = SER.CODPROD) WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA
